blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — There is no longer a need to present before the Sandiganbayan Fourth Division the witness from the Commission on Elections (Comelec) in the “gift” case trial of Sen. Rodante Marcoleta. This situation comes after both parties agreed to dispense with this person’s testimony. Marcoleta’s donor, former congressman Mike Defensor, was charged with allegedly violating Presidential Decree (PD) No. 46, which prohibits government officials from receiving and private individuals from conferring gifts. Special prosecutors presented Manuel Fortez, information technology officer of the Comelec’s political finance and affairs central office.
